title: Spiderweb Cake
description: Nothing is going to come between us and chocolate cake. Not even spiders.

items.note: plus the ingredients the box calls for

step_groups.name: Cake
steps: Butter and flour two 9-inch (23 cm) cake pans. Make the cake batter following the package instructions.
Bake following the package instructions and let the cakes cool.
Once cool, set the first cake on a platter.

step_groups.name: Frosting
steps: In a large bowl, beat the butter, confectioners' sugar, marshmallow crème, vanilla and salt with a hand mixer until fluffy and combined.

step_groups.name: Ganache and web
steps: Heat the cream in a small saucepan just until it bubbles. Put the chocolate chips in a heatproof bowl and pour the hot cream over them. Let stand 2 minutes, then whisk until the chocolate is completely combined.
Pour the ganache over the cake. Pipe a spiral of icing on top of the ganache and drag a toothpick through it to draw cobwebs.
